meta.name: host-observer
meta.description: Use this when fulfilling claude-mem observer jobs on Grok Bot: reply only skip_summary or one full observation XML, never prose.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行Grok Bot的记忆观察任务,只输出标准总结或完整观测结果。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要让机器人按规范格式输出记忆观察结果。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a bot to report memory observations in a structured format.

howto.what: 它让 Claude 只按 claude-mem 观察者任务的格式作答：空闲或无工具结果时回一行 skip_summary，完成后输出一条 observation XML，不写散文。observation 含真实标题、4–10 条带路径的事实和叙述。
howto.when: 当你在 Grok Bot 上执行 claude-mem observer 任务时接管；空闲、初始化或无工具结果时回 skip_summary，完成可搜索单元时输出一条 observation。

say.text: 这次没有工具结果，直接回 skip_summary
把这次修复写成一条 observation，标题别用工具名
say.note: 产出 4–10 条带路径的事实和叙述

say.text: 把这次决策记成一条 observation，带上路径信息

howto.what_en: It makes Claude answer only in claude-mem observer job format: a one-line skip_summary when idle or with no tool results, or one observation XML when done, never prose. It has a real title, 4–10 facts with paths, and a narrative.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you run claude-mem observer jobs on Grok Bot; it returns skip_summary when idle, initializing, or with no tool results, and one observation when a searchable unit is finished.

say_en.text: No tool results this time, just reply skip_summary
Write this bugfix as one observation, title without a tool name
say_en.note: outputs 4–10 facts with paths and a narrative

say_en.text: Record this decision as one observation with its paths
